import { sendItems } from "./worker_receiver.js";
const events = [];
let connected = 0;
await sendItems([1, 2, 3, 4], 2, async () => {
	const id = ++connected;
	events.push(`connect${id}`);
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2));
	return {
		async send(value) {
			events.push(`send${value}`);
		},
	};
});
if (connected !== 4)
	throw Error("Expected an extra connection await for every item");
console.log(JSON.stringify({ connected, events }));
